**[DigA-kog: Digital Screening for Early Detection of Mild Cognitive Impairment](project-digakog.qmd)**  
[Data collection ongoing]{.status-ongoing}&nbsp;

[MCI / Dementia]{.tag .tag-population} [Digital Assessment]{.tag .tag-method} [OCS-Plus]{.tag .tag-method} [Normative Study]{.tag .tag-method} [Multi-centre]{.tag .tag-method} [Validation]{.tag .tag-method}

::: project-card
**[Early Detection of Memory Problems in Amnestic Mild Cognitive Impairment](project-ocsplus-amci.qmd)**  
[Analysis and write-up]{.status-ongoing}&nbsp;

[MCI / Dementia]{.tag .tag-population} [Digital Assessment]{.tag .tag-method} [OCS-Plus]{.tag .tag-method} [Clinical Validation]{.tag .tag-method}

Validation study examining the OCS-Plus tablet-based test for the
detection of amnestic mild cognitive impairment, with a focus on
delayed memory as an early marker of Alzheimer's-related change.
:::

::: project-card
**[Automated Cognitive Screening: Development of the MEYOCS-plus](project-meyocsplus.qmd)**  
[Ongoing]{.status-ongoing}&nbsp;

[MCI / Dementia]{.tag .tag-population} [Parkinson's Disease]{.tag .tag-population} [Liver Disease]{.tag .tag-population} [OCS-Plus]{.tag .tag-method} [MEYOCS-plus]{.tag .tag-method} [Digital Assessment]{.tag .tag-method} [Clinical Validation]{.tag .tag-method}

Neuropsychological development of a fully automated adaptation of the 
OCS-Plus tablet test, in collaboration with industry, enabling 
self-administered cognitive screening without clinical staff. 
Now the basis of an independent validation and implementation study 
in rural healthcare settings.
:::

::: project-card
**[MS-Children: Neurodevelopment After Prenatal Exposure to MS Treatment](project-mschildren.qmd)**  
[Ongoing]{.status-ongoing}&nbsp;

[Children / Neurodevelopment]{.tag .tag-population} [Foetal Programming]{.tag .tag-method} [Multi-centre]{.tag .tag-method} [MRI / Neuroimaging]{.tag .tag-method}

Cross-sectional two-centre study examining whether prenatal exposure
to methylprednisolone used to treat MS relapses during pregnancy
affects cognitive development, behaviour, and brain structure in
school-aged children.
:::

::: project-card
**[Digital Neuropsychological Assessment: A Scoping Review](project-scoping-review.qmd)**  
[Ongoing]{.status-ongoing}  
[Neurocognitive disorders]{.tag .tag-population} [Digital Assessment]{.tag .tag-method} [Review]{.tag .tag-method}

Systematic scoping review mapping the landscape of digital
neuropsychological tests for neurocognitive disorders, examining
psychometric quality, normative data availability, and clinical
applicability across the published literature.
:::
